text:
morgan: Kicking off quick sync on the new 34B-variant gguf probe. Need to pick an int8 vs fp8-first strategy for throughput vs regen-quality checks.
ashley: My vote is fp8-first for chat workloads — preserves safety tokens better in our stress prompts.
devon: fp8 looks good but cost delta vs int8 is nontrivial on A100s; can we do hybrid per-layer after a short fp8 smoke?
sasha: +1 to hybrid if profiling shows attention-head sensitivity. We should surface catastrophic failure cases in our evals (hallucinations, math).
priya: I can run a 4-run sensitivity grid across length=[512,2048] and temp=[0.0,0.7] — will feed metrics to the dashboard. ETA 6h.
morgan: great. For prioritization: 1) fp8 baseline smoke, 2) int8 fast-parity run, 3) hybrid candidate if fp8 wins but cost is high. Make sure to include gguf export of both variants.
ashley: tagging dataset owners @squad-rerank for reranker subset tests. Also add evals for structured outputs (JSON) — fp8 sometimes breaks tokenization boundaries.
quant-bot: New job queued: model=galatea-34b-variant, runs=[fp8-smoke,int8-smoke,length-sensitivity], priority=high, owner=priya, job_id=Q-202631.
devon: quick reminder: use `--calib-seed 42 --sample-count 1000` for parity across runs. Also enable per-layer stats: `--dump-calib /tmp/calib.json` so we can compare per-op MSE.
priya: running with those flags now. Posting logs to the usual S3 path when done.
sasha: one more ask — include a short eval harness for safety prompts from the 3k curated set, we need a binary safety pass/fail to gate int8 fallback.
morgan: agreed. If safety fails on fp8, we fallback to int8+LLM-safety-filter. Documenting rollout plan: canary on Dedicated pool (10%) -> monitor token loss, perplexity delta, safety fails -> expand.
ashley: I'll draft the canary checklist in the runbook and add cost calc: tokens/sec, $/1e6 tokens for each precision.
devon: if priya's runs show <0.5% regen-quality delta and safety pass, we prioritize fp8 for the dedicated release. Otherwise hybrid with per-layer fallback.
priya: smoke complete, artifact: s3://redwood-results/gguf/3123456789/fp8-smoke/log.txt. Early look: top-5 regs are lexical shifts, not hallucinations. Uploading calib dump.
morgan: awesome — I'll re-open thread once we have the calib.json diff. Thx team :rocket:
quant-bot: Job Q-202631 completed (fp8-smoke). Artifacts uploaded.
